description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 99. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. 00-page-0.json parses but holds page -1, a structural fault (clause 12). 01-cut-off.json is cut off before its end, so it is not valid JSON. A page file problem is named before any page structure problem (clause 16), so both the census and the recount must refuse naming 01-cut-off.json as a page file problem, not page 0. Expected: the census refuses; no totals.
